title: Wonderfully Made
story:
A master craftsman was once asked how he created such beautiful handmade items.

He replied,

“I do not rush the process.”

“Every detail is intentional.”

“I shape each piece with care, knowing exactly what it will become.”

He then showed a small unfinished piece and said,

“This may look simple now, but I already know its final beauty.”

In life, people often feel incomplete.

Too slow.

Not good enough.

Still in process.

But God is not careless.

He forms each person with intention.

He sees the full design even before it is complete.

And every life is carefully shaped by His hands.
life_lesson: You are intentionally and wonderfully made by God.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for creating me with care and purpose.

Help me to see myself the way You see me.

Remove every thought that I am not enough.

Remind me that I am wonderfully made by You.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Do you struggle with feeling not good enough?

How does it change you to know God personally formed you?

What part of your identity do you need to surrender to Him today?
verse:
For You created my inmost being;
You knit me together in my mother's womb.
